meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: Claude 会从代码库里提取业务领域知识(领域、业务流、流程步骤),产出可交互的横向流程图并在仪表盘展示。若已有知识图谱就直接从它派生,否则先做一次轻量扫描。
howto.when: 当你运行 /understand-domain 时接管:已有 knowledge-graph.json 就从它派生,没有就做轻量扫描;加 --full 会强制重新扫描。

say.text: 用 /understand-domain 从这份代码库提取业务领域流程图
/understand-domain --full 重新扫描,别用旧的知识图谱
say.note: 强制做一次全新的轻量扫描

say.text: /understand-domain 生成后在仪表盘看领域视图

howto.what_en: Claude extracts domain knowledge — domains, business flows, process steps — from a codebase and builds an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard. With an existing knowledge graph it derives from it, otherwise it runs a lightweight scan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-domain: it derives from an existing knowledge graph if one exists, otherwise runs a lightweight scan; --full forces a fresh scan.

say_en.text: /understand-domain extract the business domain flow graph from this codebase
say_en.note: Writes domain-graph.json then opens the dashboard to view it

say_en.text: /understand-domain --full rescan this repo instead of reusing the old graph
/understand-domain then show me the domain view in the dashboard
say_en.note: Dashboard defaults to the domain view
